exec ctx context --bundle bundle --ticket ticket.md
! stderr .
stdout 'linked source text'
stdout '"kind":"spec"'
cp stdout complete.json
jsonresult complete.json true

rm bundle/spec.md
exit 1 ctx context --bundle bundle --ticket ticket.md
! stderr .
stdout 'source_missing'
stdout 'ticket source text'
cp stdout incomplete.json
jsonresult incomplete.json false true
